## Work log

<!-- Chronological, written as you go. What was actually done, why, what it cost.
     Reference commits and link to plans and notes. Prose beats a checklist here —
     this is the part you will actually reread in three months. -->

- Read the Yan <> Sam call of 21 Oct ([Granola](https://notes.granola.ai/d/bd194dfb-500f-4de6-ad43-f5b63a7b4489))
  and listed the MVP fixes against the 13 Oct preview.
- Drew nine mockup boards on a Claude canvas, using real pages and the site's palette:
  [Riverbanks MVP mockups](https://claude.ai/artifact/5N9u5BM2rdNbbjKcEDRKor).
- Sam's intro copy (shared as a screenshot) transcribed to `src/content/intro.md`.
- Wrote the [MVP roadmap](../plans/2026-10-29_mvp-roadmap.plan.md): F0–F5 in three phases. Each
  feature gets its own plan next.
- F0 [Premiere Edition refresh](../plans/2026-10-29_premiere-edition-refresh.plan.md): took the
  site's PREVIEW strip off the reader, and added the Premiere Edition / CC BY-NC line and meta.
- Read the compilation comic over the new `riverbanks` MCP. It is 52 pages now, with new covers,
  and Act Four is *Gross Deliciousness Index* again (my rename from the 12 Oct PDF was wrong, and is reverted).
- The reader now shows only the chapters (Yan): `Edition.last`, no Cover group, and the posters
  and front pages stay in the PDF. Tests were written first.
- Set Sam's footer on the compilation comic over MCP (rev 299–345). Generator `219b51e` sets the
  footer centre in Rubik Light; it is pushed to production.
- Wrote the [F1 page-reader plan](../plans/2026-10-29_page-reader.plan.md). A spike decides the
  engine: PhotoSwipe is recommended, and native scroll-snap is kept only as the baseline. F1 now
  owns `/p/[n]`, and F2 is narrowed to sharing.
- No iPad today, so F1 was built on PhotoSwipe straight away: `/p/[n]`, controls, keyboard, the
  end card, and a home page that links in. Checked in desktop Chrome. Preview:
  https://riverbanks-microsite-11g9zrz0t-yanthibicos-projects.vercel.app/p/15
